A table Enrolment(student_id, course_id) may contain many courses per student. Which query returns students enrolled in more than three distinct courses?
options: SELECT student_id FROM Enrolment WHERE COUNT(course_id) > 3 GROUP BY student_id;
SELECT student_id FROM Enrolment GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) > 3;
SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM Enrolment HAVING course_id > 3;
SELECT student_id FROM Enrolment ORDER BY COUNT(course_id) > 3;
answer: SELECT student_id FROM Enrolment GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) > 3;

options: It has O(n²) worst-case time and O(1) auxiliary space

question: Which statement best describes polymorphism in object-oriented programming?
options: A class can have no methods

answer: Different object types can provide a common interface with type-specific behaviour
